shortBio.en: Oasis chief songwriter/guitarist; later Noel Gallagher’s High Flying Birds after the classic lineup ended.
shortBio.zh: Oasis 主要词曲/吉他手；经典阵容结束后有 Noel Gallagher’s High Flying Birds。

whyHub.en: Songwriter hub who outlasts classic Oasis into a solo continuum; sibling pair with Liam is part of the object.
whyHub.zh: 活过经典 Oasis 进入独唱连续统的词曲枢纽；与 Liam 的兄弟对是对象的一部分。

body.en:
Born 1967, Manchester. Writes the Britpop-peak singles; open-chord craft and terrace-scale choruses. Feud with Liam is documented public history, not only gossip.

Read beside Liam as a Person pair: same band, incompatible orbits. Solo years keep the writing voice moving.
body.zh:
1967 年生于曼彻斯特。写作 Britpop 巅峰单曲；开放和弦工艺与看台尺度副歌。与 Liam 的争执属有文献的公共史，不只是八卦。

与 Liam 作为人物对阅读：同一乐队，不相容轨道。独唱年代让写作声线继续移动。
